android.extraProguardRules:
# Backport of expo/expo#46852 (Expo SDK 58) for R8 optimization on SDK 57.
# Keep the Record marker interface so expo-modules-core's own
# '-keep class * implements expo.modules.kotlin.records.Record' rule still matches once
# R8 optimization is allowed to remove empty marker interfaces.
-keep interface expo.modules.kotlin.records.Record
# SDK 57's reflection-based Record conversion is only fixed for optimized builds in SDK 58,
# so do not optimize it here (shrinking and obfuscation still apply).
-keep,allowshrinking,allowobfuscation class expo.modules.kotlin.records.** { *; }
